task: Read-only next-renderer source comparison after NekoMote mask failure
summary_zh: artemis-compat更值得做下一轮组合变形审计：它实际解析combinatorList/rawMeshList并按变量求值4×4网格，KrkrSDL3插件没有这三类字段的消费者。遮罩方面，artemis对容器来源仍收集全部后代可绘制层，随后采样未遮罩alpha，未证明避开NekoMote的自包含来源问题；Krkr只调用标签节点自身draw，不递归容器来源，复合遮罩更弱。artemis还缺hair/bust物理，不能视为完整替换。

mesh_combinator.judgment: No meshCombinator/combinatorList/rawMeshList consumer exists in the 10 examined E-mote plugin source/header files. Frame bp and separate meshCombine fields are present; these are not equivalent to the missing resource-backed combinator programs.

stencil_sources.collection: stencilCompositeMaskLayerList resolves each label through currentNode->_rootmotion->getNodeByName and refMtn->getNodeRef; only those named refs are stored.
stencil_sources.render: For each named ref, invokes maskLayer->draw(renderer,maskTarget,lim,nullptr). This is not emotemotionref::draw's recursive motion traversal.
stencil_sources.limitations: emotenoderef::draw immediately rejects !isIcon. Type3 motion/container sources are not thereby expanded into all their drawable descendants. The code comments explicitly exclude composite masks. There is no basis to claim this fixes Yuki's type3 source semantics.

evidence.fact: Named-source lookup, not descendant membership scan.
Own-node draw requires isIcon; mask pass invokes the same draw with null maskTarget.
Separate whole-motion draw recursively expands nested motions; the mask-source call does not call this function.

mesh_combinator.parsing: Parses field.combinatorList. rawMeshList is a normal or extra PSB resource; byte length must equal meshCount*128. Decodes float32LE interleaved XY 4x4 grids.
mesh_combinator.evaluation: Maps each variable to a clamped adjacent-mesh interpolation and sums grid samples. Cached combinators are actually consumed by EmoteScene evaluation, with priority over frame bp.
mesh_combinator.supported: meshType=1; entryType absent/default0; valid finite nondegenerate ranges, meshCount/neutralIndex and resource bounds; budgets entry8MiB, cumulative64MiB, <=4096 entries.
mesh_combinator.limits: Same-domain ancestor meshCombine only in proven contexts; low meshSync channels/cc/unproven combine are recorded or degraded rather than equivalent full support.

evidence.fact: Scene invokes evaluator and installs combinator patch.

stencil_sources.collection: Drawable label: picks nearest visible source by center distance. Container label with no drawable own content: collects every drawable l2 whose hierarchical key starts with container_key+'.'. It does not stop at nested stencil boundaries in this loop.
stencil_sources.render: Compositor::RenderStageMask renders raw source texture alpha with transformed/warped geometry, ignoring source effects/stage masks; comment explicitly avoids self-target sampling.
stencil_sources.judgment: Does not have NekoMote's same UnsupportedMask assertion, but source-plus-content self-inclusion can persist as a visual semantic error. Loading/rendering success must not be interpreted as correct source traversal.
stencil_sources.fallback: Unresolved source sets or sources that produce no mask return zero and can leave the content unmasked; this needs explicit verification rather than a PASS label.

evidence.fact: Nearest-source and container fallback source collection.
Raw source alpha, no source-effect evaluation.

recommendation.claim_boundary: More promising for the 43 resource-backed meshCombinator fields, not an already compatible Yuki renderer. Mask source/content semantics and missing physics remain.
recommendation.no_current_verification: Neither project was built or run on Yuki or KV260 in this check; no runtime/GPU compatibility claim.
